profile.headline: Senior Technical Leader - Autonomous Vehicles, IoT and Scalable Internet Applications
profile.summary:
Technologist, Strategist and Entrepreneur.

Specialties: 
• R&D professional with experience in building highly scalable applications.
• IoT + Home/Building Security & Automation platform development:  
  • Verkada: Scaled and enhanced their Alarms product used by thousands of business/schools/stores. 
  • Caspar.AI: IoT platform for multi-family dwelling & senior community centers.
  • Alarms.COM/ADT: Popular as "ADT Pulse" solution and used at millions of homes - I worked on nearly every part of server technologies, tools; customer services & home user facing features. Scaled server from 0 - multi-millions homes & devices. 
• Hands on professional with ability to bring ideas to reality & build teams to support and sustain products.
• IOT - Home Automation & Security, Sports and Wearables, Industrial; AWS Cloud developement; Databases; Network Management Systems; Enterprise (CRM) Applications; Social Networking.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Foster City, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Bringing autonomous vehicle to places near you!

positions.title: Co-Founder / CTO / Software Engineer
positions.description: Founded PeersNet to help small business and non-profits to create their online presence. Provided web services infrastructure to create and manage online communities of customers and users of their products, services and solution. As chief technology leader, developed multi-tenant software platform to allow quick and easy building of custom web applications; build & manage offshore technical team. Our customers included students coaching institutes, schools, doctors, speciality shops, non-profit communities.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Mateo, California, United States · On-site
positions.description: Build the world's largest cloud-based B2B physical security system.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Redwood City, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Architect & build Caspar’s AI based IOT platform.  As a technology leader – mentor team in designing, deploying & operating services.

Caspar’s AI (BrainOfT) ver1 targeted towards multi-dwelling housing and apartments & adapted home settings automatically to users preferences:
- Scale to thousands of apartments: Re-architect, design & develop apartment <–> cloud messaging system over Kafka/MQTT/Nats/AWS IoT Core; Multi-level cloud (AWS-Local Cloud in Property-Apartment) for local processing. Build monitoring & alerting solution for operations, application & end-user metrics.
- Enhance Home Hub hardware platform development (Pi based, 3rd party HW).
- Support Operations; Monitor AWS Resource Usage - optimize for upgrades, maintenance & costs.

Carpar.AI 's latest offering for AI-driven  patient insights & care:
- Re-architect platform to focus on care industry.
- Implement backend modules to analyze IoT data to generate sleep summaries.

Skills: Kafka, MQTT, Nats/RabbitMQ, Redis, Postgres, Java/JavaScript/Python, Kubernetes, Terraform & Vault, AWS (EKS/ECS/RDS/IoT Core/MQTT), Docker, Opendistro/ELK, Node/Angular/React/GraphQL/gRPC, Hun – Pi/Rockchip

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Alarm acquired IcontrolNetworks (see below) 's ADT product line.

positions.title: IoT Technology & Software Engineer
positions.description:
Provide technology consulting at Icontrol Networks to help them build IOT/home security & automation system. This is the main SW behind ADT Pulse, Comcast Xfinity Home and many other similar services in use by millions of home users. 

Worked and enhanced almost all parts of their stack, across layers and business units. 
•	Architect, design and developed from scratch, a rich Rest based API framework & server container and event bus system to handle custom needs.
•	Scale product with newer technologies - including RabbitMQ, Kafka, Cassandra and other big data processing for device analytics. Lead Amazon Cloud based products & services initiatives. 
•	Support complex server/data center side customer issues at ADT Pulse & Icontrol One operations. Defined and developed custom low level tools for server management, including Erlang modules for RabbitMQ monitoring, application level view and usage of event bus, etc.

positions.title: Expert Tech. Consultant
positions.description: As as expert member of professional services & liaison between engineering, various customer projects - investigate critical performance and application issues in implementation; co-ordinate tasks; provide feedback for product enhancements.

positions.title: Lead for Sys. Mgmt. & Tools
positions.description: Lead system management & data migration tools for Kickfire's (now part of Teradata) hardware based MySQL data warehouse appliance.

positions.title: Sr. Expert - Software Dev.
positions.description:
Design & develop Clarify’s CRM product for Tele-communication Service Providers and other industries. This was previously Nortel’s e-business division, now owned by Amdocs.
•	Architect for Amdoc’s future Rich Client Platform.
•	Proposed and championed "Java" as future client-platform by developing prototypes for proof-of-concept and performance evaluation; and by providing effective migration strategies for existing applications. Designed  language convertor using compiler technologies and HTML parsers to translate high-level information in exisiting forms to Java Swing forms.
•	Acted in lead role to design and develop re-usable complex user interface components for CRM Applications.
•	Lead Health-Care Vertical for CRM Applications.

positions.title: Sr. Staff - Software Dev.
positions.description:
Design & develop Optivity - SNMP based Network Management System.
•	Evaluated tools and technologies for product improvements. 
•	Design and develop client GUI framework for front end NMS applications and the main console (InfoCenter) for the product.
•	Received Nortel Networks Pride Award twice.
•	Filed Patent for  Integrated Multiple Network Management Systems.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
Software Consultant at
•	Sun Microsystems, Inc., Menlo Park, CA - worked in Solstice Enterprise Manager - NMS product group
•	Transamerica Financial Services, Los Angeles, CA in a data warehousing project.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked in L&T's (India) Software Export Group. Projects -
•	SNMP Proxy Agent for Ascom Timeplex, New Jersey.
•	Data Analysis System for Sechron, AG. Switzeland.
•	L&Ts database software development product - APEX.
